items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Lucky had in the trumpets, he had Nottingham, he had Reynauld Jones, had Joe Wilder, and Frank Galbreath.

ctx.x: -- so, anyway, I went with Lucky and he fired me and he took Gene Simon back. He fired me and hired two white trombone players. Yeah, Freddie Zito -- and a dear friend of mine, too, Freddie is. We worked in the house band at the Waldorf together. And Porky Cohen was a very dear friend of mine. Porky Cohen was the only white trombone player I knew that could play the plunger. He played the plunger with Charlie Barnet when Charlie used to play Duke's arrangements, and Porky Cohen was the plunger. He played the…
And the trumpets? He had -- Lucky had in the trumpets, he had Nottingham, he had Reynauld Jones, had Joe Wilder, and Frank Galbreath. That was the trumpets.
